segments.name: Hook
segments.purpose: Pattern interrupt — stop the scroll in under 1 second
segments.narrative_role: Pose a provocative question or state an uncomfortable truth
aesthetic_constraints: Photorealistic cinematic (NOT 3D render, NOT illustration)
Moody corporate lighting, Rembrandt style
Architectural digest scale
Character must look imposing and ageless
Impossible physics signature (rotating halos, still water)
segments.reusable_asset_note: Generate Hook environment once, reuse across all reels

segments.name: Tension
segments.purpose: Define the uncomfortable truth the viewer is living with
segments.narrative_role: Name the pain, name the cost, name the hidden trade-off
aesthetic_constraints: Text-forward or data-forward — viewer must READ something
Dark background with bold typography
Minimal, austere, intellectual
NOT UGC iPhone aesthetic (Quantum Tools is not consumer-casual)
Brand palette: #0a0a0f bg, #6c63ff accent, #ffd166 emphasis
segments.typical_text_overlay: The data point or cost (e.g. '£150K/yr on research that doesn\'t differentiate')
segments.reusable_asset_note: Generated fresh per idea — content varies

segments.name: Pivot
segments.purpose: Introduce the solution via unarguable logic
segments.narrative_role: Show the new way — here is what works, here is why
aesthetic_constraints: Dark background (#0a0a0f)
Purple (#6c63ff) and gold (#ffd166) accents only
Playfair Display for headlines, DM Sans for labels
Non-3D charts — no flashy BI dashboard look
Data must be specific and legible
Rapid metric reveals, animated counters
segments.typical_text_overlay: The new metric or framework (e.g. '5 sources. 1 figure. 100% auditable.')
segments.reusable_asset_note: Template-based — reuse chart style, vary data

segments.name: Proof
segments.purpose: Show the actual product doing the thing (not a claim, an artefact)
segments.narrative_role: Here is the output. Here is what happens when you use this.
aesthetic_constraints: Real product output (Excel diagnostic, PRISM benchmark, Atlas report)
Fast cuts if multiple views (max 1 second per cut)
Subtle zoom-in to key numbers or phrases
Dark theme consistent with brand
NO generic office stock footage
segments.typical_text_overlay: Caption pointing to the key data (e.g. '2,847 employees. 12 functions. 5 minutes.')

segments.name: Bookend
segments.purpose: Return to Hook state, deliver the CTA
segments.narrative_role: Close the loop — come back to the character, land the action
aesthetic_constraints: EXACT same environment as Hook (no deviation)
Same character pose family (can be variant — seated → leaning, walking → standing)
Same colour grade, same lens, same lighting
End on a held frame for 0.5s before cut
Character 'addresses' the viewer (helmet turns toward camera)
segments.typical_text_overlay: The single action (e.g. 'See it run. quantumtools.ai')

inviolable_rules: Hook and Bookend must match exactly
Character is always Theo, generated via startFrame from hero.png
Hyper-stylised aesthetic (Hook/Bookend) never blends with data-led (Tension/Pivot/Proof)
Voice is continuous — Google TTS Charon with British RP directive
No founder face, no human presenter, no recorded footage
